figurative_meaning_en: The sole housewife with full authority
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার পরিবারের একেশ্বরী, সবকিছু তার হাতে।
গ্রামের বাড়িতে মা একেশ্বরী হিসেবে সব দেখাশোনা করেন।
example_sentences_in_english: She is the ekeshwari of her family, handling everything.
In the village home, the mother acts as the sole authority over household matters.
note: The term draws from divine imagery to elevate the role of the housewife in traditional Bengali families.
